nodes.name: signalBridge.ts
nodes.summary: Subscribes to Supabase realtime channels for a template to apply debounced slot, suggestion, and validation-hint updates into the local Zustand store, and publishes outbound signal events.

nodes.name: store.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand-style per-instance store factory holding template editor state (slots, suggestions, validation hints, AB variants, calibration metadata) with pure-function setters.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts
nodes.summary: Thin emit helper that fires Mini-UI telemetry events through a registered logger callback or window.console fallback.

nodes.name: TemplateMiniUI.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level Mini-UI shell that wires the signal bridge, preview kernel, keyboard router, and right-rail panels (Dashboard, Scripts, Optimize, A/B, Inception, Validate) for a single template and platform.

nodes.name: TemplateMiniUIProvider.tsx
nodes.summary: React context provider that exposes the Mini-UI store, router, and signal bridge to descendants and syncs the open-panel state with the URL hash.

nodes.name: tokenMeter.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks AI token usage budgets per template editing session and emits warnings when the configured cap is approached or exceeded.

nodes.name: validation.ts
nodes.summary: Pure validation engine that runs the Mini-UI rule set across all seven template slots and returns structured hints with severity, slot, and suggested fix.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Mini-UI v1 architecture document covering signal bridge, preview kernel, panels, keyboard shortcuts, accessibility, feature flag, and integration contract.
